camel_example: aliyun esa ListRoutineBuilds --region cn-hangzhou --RoutineName 'test-routine' --Status canceled --PageSize 500 --SortBy CreateTime --SortOrder asc --PageIndex 1
description_en: Retrieves the list of ER build tasks
name: ListRoutineBuilds

parameters.help_en:
The status of the build task. Valid values:

int: initialization
pending: preparing
building: building
succeed: build succeeded
failed: build failed
canceled: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
构建任务的状态，取值范围：

int：初始化
pending：准备中
building：构建中
succeed：构建成功
failed：构建失败
canceled：已取消
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

CreateTime: purchase time.
ExpireTime: expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

CreateTime：新购时间。
ExpireTime：到期时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标识，默认为降序。支持：

asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_index
